note: Brazil surfaces the measurement half plus the attestation that makes it payable. The distinctive step is not the arithmetic, it is that a public body cannot pay against a measurement nobody attested: the fiscal do contrato signs the boletim de medicao, the expense is liquidated, and only then does the nota fiscal have anything to attach to. So this layer surfaces register, measure, value, certify, invoice and reconcile, and leaves the clock steps to the regimes that count days rather than approvals.
title: Attest the boletim de medicao and invoice the period
desc: Measure the period against the planilha orcamentaria, price it at the contract rates, have the fiscal do contrato attest the boletim de medicao and raise the nota fiscal against the attested figure, so the expense can be liquidated instead of sitting in a queue nobody can explain.
longDesc: In a Brazilian contract the money does not move because the work was done, it moves because the work was measured, attested and liquidated in that order, and each of those is a document with a name and a signatory. A nota fiscal issued ahead of the boletim de medicao it should reference is the single most common reason a payment stalls, because there is nothing for the accounts to match it to and the person who could fix it is not the person holding the invoice. Measured against the planilha item by item, the attestation is a signature on a figure both sides have already seen rather than a negotiation that starts when the invoice arrives.
